sn22.120:1.2: saññojaniye ca bhikkhave, dhamme desissāmi saññojanañca,
sn22.120:1.4: katame ca bhikkhave, saññojaniyā dhammā, katamaṃ saññojanaṃ:
sn22.120:1.6: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn22.120:1.7: vedanā saññojaniyo dhammo. yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn22.120:1.11: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn22.120:1.12: ime vuccanti bhikkhave, saññoniyā dhammā, idaṃ saññojananti.
